plan.title: bug: npm update leaves stale frozen-bridge files in .deft/core

narratives.Description: After a frozen Go-bridge deposit, `directive update` leaves hundreds of package-absent files under `.deft/core/` because the file-swap is additive and only prunes the hard-coded `packages/` stray path. Consumers can commit a v0.84.0 VERSION alongside bridge-era trees while Doctor still reports clean deposit hygiene. This story makes update converge the deposit file-set to the content package (preserving generated metadata such as VERSION) and makes Doctor fail when package-absent files remain.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Extend `packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.ts` (and the refresh call site in `packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.ts`) so file-swap prunes deposit paths absent from `@deftai/directive-content`, with an allowlist for generated deposit metadata such as `VERSION`. 2. Add a Doctor deposit file-set check (wired where the existing packages/ hygiene check lives) that fails when package-absent files remain. 3. Cover the prune + Doctor paths with focused tests in `packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.test.ts` and `packages/cli/src/doctor.test.ts` that seed bridge-era leftovers and assert removal plus a failing Doctor finding.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive consumer upgrading from the frozen bridge, I want update and Doctor to remove or flag package-absent deposit files, so that my `.deft/core/` matches the published content package.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Migrating a legacy consumer with the frozen `v0.58.0` Go bridge and then running `directive update` at `0.84.0` leaves hundreds of stale bridge-era files under `.deft/core/`, even though update reports a successful file-swap and Doctor reports clean deposit hygiene.

## Reproduction

1. Start with a legacy `deft/` consumer.
2. Run the verified frozen v0.58.0 bridge into `.deft/core/`.
3. Install `@deftai/directive@0.84.0` and run `directive update`.
4. Hash-compare `.deft/core/` with the installed `@deftai/directive-content@0.84.0` package.

Observed: all 327 package files match byte-for-byte, but the deposit has 230 package-absent files, including old `cmd/deft-install/**`, legacy `vbrief/**`, historical docs, Go/Python metadata, and obsolete root files. The generated `VERSION` manifest is the only expected deposit-local file in this class.

## Expected

The file-swap removes files not present in the current content package, preserving only explicit generated deposit metadata such as `VERSION`.

## Actual

Stale v0.58.0 files survive and can be committed under a v0.84.0 manifest. `directive doctor --full` reports deposit hygiene clean because its current check catches only selected paths such as stray `packages/`.

A deterministic package-vs-deposit file-set check in update/Doctor would prevent this.

items.title: Given a deposit with package-absent bridge leftovers, when update file-swaps, then those paths are removed while VERSION remains.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a `.deft/core/` deposit that contains package-absent bridge leftovers such as `cmd/deft-install/`, when `directive update` runs a file-swap, then those package-absent paths are deleted and the generated `VERSION` file remains.

items.title: Given package-absent files remain in the deposit, when Doctor runs full hygiene, then it fails with a deposit file-set finding.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a `.deft/core/` deposit that still contains package-absent files after an incomplete prune, when `directive doctor --full` runs, then deposit hygiene fails with a clear package-vs-deposit file-set finding instead of reporting clean.

items.title: Given a deposit that already matches the content package, when update and Doctor run, then they report a clean no-op prune.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a `.deft/core/` deposit whose file-set already matches `@deftai/directive-content` plus allowlisted generated metadata, when update and Doctor run, then no extra files are deleted and Doctor reports clean deposit hygiene.

expected_outputs: hygiene and doctor deposit file-set tests pass
package-absent prune covered with VERSION allowlist
